extracted.name: Chia Gel
extracted.description: Chia seeds in water makes a gel simply and quickly.
instruction_lines: Combine water and chia seeds in a small, sealable jar. Shake 5 seconds; rest 1 minute. Shake 15 seconds more; refrigerate until gelatinous, about 10 minutes.
